Today we're deciding: Decide on a shared productivity tool for a newly merged team. Here are the options:
Option A - Trello: cost $10/user/month, learning curve easy, features boards, lists, cards
Option B - Asana: cost $15/user/month, learning curve medium, features tasks, projects, workflows
Option C - Notion: cost $8/user/month, learning curve hard, features notes, databases, pages
Option D - Basecamp: cost $20/user/month, learning curve easy, features message boards, file sharing, schedules
What matters most to us when choosing a shared productivity tool?
